M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer - Node.JS at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can thrive in a fast-paced environment developing complex applications to join our cutting-edge engineering team. Our ideal candidate would demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts and development lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object-oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices. You'll be responsible for assisting with system design, coding, improving application performance, collaborating with other developers, and assisting with testing.

  • Lead and supervise the development team, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, aligned with Agile methodologies, and meet quality standards.
  • Design, implement, and deliver highly scalable solutions based on modern cloud-based architecture.
  • Continuously develop, release, monitor, and improve our systems and services while fostering a culture of accountability within the team.
  • Set and actively promote software development processes and best practices, providing mentorship to team members.
  • Participate in and facilitate Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives, to ensure alignment and progress tracking.
  • Provide regular status updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and clear communication of progress, roadblocks, and timelines.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers across the organization to shape high-impact solutions and deliver high-quality applications.
  • Take responsibility for the team’s deliverables, ensuring scope is maintained and work is delivered iteratively while embracing Agile principles.
Qualifications
  • Strong expertise in Node.js , with experience building scalable and efficient backend systems and APIs.
  • SQL and familiarity with relational databases like Oracle or similar platforms.
  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks, specifically React or Angular , and familiarity with Bootstrap for UI development.
  • Exposure to additional languages and frameworks such as PL/SQL, Java/JSP, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Ruby, and ColdFusion is beneficial but not mandatory.
  • Proficient with source control tools like Git for collaborative development and versioning.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and familiarity with standards like OWASP Top Ten and SANS CWE , with a commitment to adapting to evolving security threats through audits and ongoing education.
  • Team-oriented with exceptional collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional multitasking abilities , capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • An analytical mindset with superior problem-solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques.
  • Familiarity with mobile-first development and responsive design is a plus.
AI and Automation Expectations
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and coding tools that improve development velocity and software quality.
  • Ability to apply AI across the Node.js lifecycle, including implementation, refactoring, debugging, and unit/integration test creation.
  • Experience using AI to strengthen CI/CD and quality engineering practices (test generation, flaky test analysis, release validation, and review support).
  • Proven ability to design or integrate automation that increases team efficiency, reduces repetitive work, and improves delivery consistency.
  • Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information.
  • Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects).
Additional Information
  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English

A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para coordenar nosso time administrativo-financeiro e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres. A coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno é a responsável, juntamente com a gestão executiva, por analisar, gerenciar e implementar sistemas e processos administrativos e financeiros eficientes e transparentes na organização. Ela é responsável pela coordenação e acompanhamento da equipe da área, pela elaboração de orçamentos e relatórios de prestação de contas, controle de fluxo de caixa e conciliação bancária. As ações da organização são focadas em promover a redução dos estereótipos nocivos e da violência baseados no gênero. A Empodera trabalha com o desenvolvimento e execução de metodologias esportivas, treinamentos e suporte técnico de organizações em prol de uma sociedade mais justa e equânime.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING CONDITIONS- Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.- Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.- Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.- Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.QUALIFICATIONSRequired- Bachelor’s degree- 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.- Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.- Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.- Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.- Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.- Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.- Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred- Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.- Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions- Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.- Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HEREConservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.#J-18808-Ljbffr

business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

The Senior Manager plays a critical role in ensuring creative excellence, experience consistency, and strong cross‑functional orchestration—bringing marketing plans to life in ways that drive relevance, conversion, and growth.This role requires a strategic thinker with creative mindset and strong executional rigor—someone who can turn insights into clear creative challenges, manage complexity, and lead agencies and internal teams to deliver impactful work.Key Responsibilities1. Integrated Planning & Consumer Experience- Lead the development ofend-to-end experience strategiesfor assigned brands or categories, aligned with broader regional and global direction.- Translate business and category objectives intoclear creative and experience briefs, grounded in consumer and shopper insights.- Design marketing plans around theconsumer journey and shopper path, ensuring continuity and effectiveness across touchpoints.- Contribute to long‑term experience platforms, while ensuring strong execution of annual and campaign plans.2. Creative Strategy & Execution- Partner with Brand, Category, and Creative Strategy teams to shapecreative territories and communication strategies.- Develop high‑quality creative briefs and lead agencies through ideation, development, and refinement.- Apply creative judgment tochallenge, guide, and elevate ideas, ensuring work is on‑brand, culturally relevant, and effective.- Ensure consistency of brand storytelling across content, channels, and markets.- Support the amplification ofGlobal Core Creative Ideasinto relevant LATAM executions.3. End‑to‑End Orchestration & Delivery- Take ownership of assigned initiativesfrom planning through execution, ensuring alignment, prioritization, and timely delivery.- Orchestrate cross‑functional teams including media, digital, design, consumer & shopper engagement, and commercial partners.- Manage agency relationships (creative, media, production), ensuring clarity of scope, quality output, and efficiency.- Balance ambition withtimelines, budgets, and resources, escalating risks and trade‑offs as needed.- Ensure coherence and integration across all consumer connection points.4. Media, Digital & Performance Orientation- Collaborate with media, digital, and DAO teams to ensure plans reflectevolving media behaviors, e‑commerce, and platform dynamics.- Support performance tracking, measurement, and learning agendas.- Analyze campaign and experience results, translating insights intooptimization and future planning inputs.- Contribute to improving ROI and effectiveness of integrated marketing investments.5. Collaboration, Influence & Leadership- Act as a key connector between Brand, Category, IMX, E2E, Media, and Commercial teams.- Communicate clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, providing recommendations and rationale.- Lead specific workstreams or project teams;
mentor junior team members where applicable.- Build strong working relationships with bottlers and external partners.- Collaborate with OU and global counterparts to ensure alignment and best‑practice sharing.Organizational Impact- Owns delivery ofdefined initiatives and workstreamswithin integrated marketing plans.- Contributes to operational planning and execution within an established strategic framework.- Influences decisions related to project plans, sequencing, and resource use within assigned scope.Qualifications & Experience- Bachelor’s degree required.- 8–12 years of progressive experience in marketing, integrated marketing, and creative strategy, including hands‑on experience working with or within agency environments.- Experience inconsumer and shopper marketing;
CPG experience stronglypreferred.- Demonstrated ability to develop and executeintegrated marketing and experience strategies.- Strong understanding ofdigital ecosystems, media, culture, and content development.- Experience working with external agencies and cross‑functional internal teams.- Proven ability to manage complexity, prioritize effectively, and deliver high‑quality work.- Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills.What We Offer- Opportunity to work on iconic, category‑leading brands.- Exposure to integrated, end‑to‑end marketing strategy and execution at scale.- A collaborative, creative environment that values curiosity, craft, and consumer‑centricity.- Strong partnership with regional and global teams and world‑class agencies.- A role that builds depth and readiness for future Director‑level leadership.Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Agency Management, Arts Education, Creative Briefs, Creative Design, Creative Directing, Graphic Design, Motion Graphics, Photography, Relationship Building, Storyboards, Strategic Thinking, UI UX (Inactive), User Experience (UX) Design, Visual Design, Visual Graphics (Inactive), Waterfall ModelLocation(s): MexicoCity/Cities: MexicoTravel Required: 26% - 50%Relocation Provided: NoJob Posting End Date: April 13, 2026Our Purpose and Growth Culture:We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca‑Cola.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Accounting Manager

transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key ResponsibilitiesOversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.RequirementsExperience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLEWe are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSIONAt Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist

You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. title: Llm Scientist
description: We are looking for an\ "LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.Key ResponsibilitiesDesign and execute experiments by conducting ablation title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager - Remote
description: About UsAt Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to dataFor more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.Why You’re HereYou’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.Com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.You’re here to:- Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping.- Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content.- Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale.What You’ll Deliver- Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross-channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences.- AI-Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale.- Channel Identification: Build presence in ecosystems like Reddit, Hackernews, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, X, dev.To, substack, and emerging platforms (which you’ll need to identify).- Social Media & Community: Manage Zyte’s social presence with an eye for authenticity and cutting-edge social plays.- Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs.Quantitative- New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)- Content engagement (CTR, CVR, downloads, shares)Qualitative- Innovation in AI-driven content repurposing- Speed and creativity of campaign execution- Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content- Cross-team collaboration and impact on broader demand gen goalsWho You Are- Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.- Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery.- AI-Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.- Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.- Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.Requirements- 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products- Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills- Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.- (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer toolsTech You’ll work with- HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics- Figma, Notion, Google Workspace- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideationHow We WorkWe move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.As a new Zytan, you will:Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head Of Legal

We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive;
the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets, requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. investor relations from a legal standpoint- Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructureYou can be a Rock-Star if you haveCore Skills & Experience- Law degree with active OAB ideally from a startup angle- Due diligence (legal & regulatory)- Complex contract structuring and negotiation- International contracts and cross-border operations- Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.G., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)- Solid experience with:- Corporate law and governance- Investor relations and strategic partnerships- Fluency in English, with experience working in international environmentsKey Qualities- Business-oriented mindset: understands legal as a driver of growth- Highly relational: strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions- Strategic thinker: connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks- Pragmatic and solution-driven: balances risk with execution speed- High ownership: comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure- Strong institutional presence: capable of representing the company externally- Structured and integrative: able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains- Neutral and sound judgment, especially in complex or sensitive mattersBonus Points (but not essential)- Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets- Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms- Exposure to governance and international structures- Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)- Business and legal experience in Germany- Speaks German- Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SPLiving Our ValuesAt InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. title: Técnico De Serviços Em Maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito. A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês. Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo: Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado. Tipos de equipamentos atendidos: - Radares - ECDIS - Satcoms - Rádios HF e VHF - GPS - Girobússola - Pilotos automáticos - Sirenes Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima: - Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.
- Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.
- Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
- Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.
- Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.
- Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima. Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations. Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply. - Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices. Must Have - Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer - Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

.Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;
.Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;
.Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;

.Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;
.Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;
.Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;

.Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia. Pré-requisitos: .Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;
.Experiência anteriorem rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;
.Excel intermediário ou avançado;
.Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;
.Facilidade decomunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas. Desejável: .Conhecimento em Sienge;
.Experiência em obrascom múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;
.Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;
.Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira. Outras informações: .Regime: CLT .Carga Horária: 44 horas semanais - Presencial (segunda a sexta-feira) .Local: Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro .Benefícios: vale assiduidade, plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e vale-transporte

o cumprimento de prazos legais e a manutenção organizada da documentação para eventuais auditorias e fiscalizações.Contribuir com o processo decisório da organização, mediante análise crítica de informações e elaboração de relatórios e consolidações contábeis confiáveis e tempestivas, de modo a subsidiar a gestão financeira e estratégica.Assegurar o perfeito funcionamento dos sistemas de contabilidade e custos, promovendo a integridade das informações e o cumprimento dos prazos de fechamento e reportes contábeis.Atender auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações e documentos solicitados, acompanhando recomendações e assegurando a execução das correções ou ajustes necessários.Manter-se atualizado quanto às legislações contábil, fiscal e tributária, avaliando impactos e implementando ajustes nos processos internos, visando eliminar riscos e garantir conformidade legal.Identificar oportunidades e propor melhorias nos processos da área, buscando aumentar a eficiência, reduzir erros e promover a automação e padronização das rotinas contábeis.Zelar pelos equipamentos, recursos e materiais sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando a conservação e organização do ambiente de trabalho, conforme as normas e procedimentos internos.Cumprir a Missão, Visão e Valores institucionais, o regulamento interno, os requisitos de compliance e dos sistemas de gestão da qualidade, bem como as regulamentações da ANS, ANVISA e as normas de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho, utilizando os EPI's/EPC's (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual/Coletivo) quando exigido title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights. You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making. Responsibilities Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively Requirements Strong SQL skills Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics Comfortable working in a remote environment Able to pass a background check Preferred Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data Experience with BI and visualization tools Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment Experience with AWS-based data environments Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts How to Apply Please send your resume in English.

Durante anos, vimos de perto o mesmo padrão se repetir: psicólogos tecnicamente bons, mas inseguros na condução clínica, frágeis na construção da própria carreira e presos a um modelo de profissão que cobra muito, devolve pouco e quase sempre empurra o profissional para o improviso. Mais do que uma clínica, desenvolvemos um ambiente de formação aplicada para psicólogos que desejam crescer com profundidade, supervisão, direção e responsabilidade. Aqui, o profissional não entra apenas para atender. Ele entra para aprender a sustentar uma prática clínica mais madura, mais estruturada e mais coerente com a realidade da profissão.Nosso modelo combina atendimento real, supervisão clínica, mentoria profissional e desenvolvimento de visão de carreira. Acreditamos que psicólogo não deve ser formado apenas para sobreviver de sessão em sessão, mas para construir presença, clareza, valor e autonomia ao longo do tempo.Por isso, a Clínica FT busca profissionais e futuros profissionais que queiram mais do que uma contratação. Buscamos pessoas que queiram fazer parte de uma formação viva, exigente e transformadora, dentro de uma estrutura que leva a sério tanto o cuidado com o paciente quanto a construção do psicólogo que sustenta esse cuidado. Commitment to fostering a healthy, inclusive team culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous learning. If we like you, you'll be given a 90-day trial period. If you have a project you want to realize, and believe it can benefit from our support, then you can always ask for a vote. If your idea passes the vote, we will partner with your dream and scale it with you. Why Us? We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. SVC and TGA Fund invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our organizations. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Application: Please fill out the Google Form below in order to apply: Tip: Please take your time and answer these questions thoroughly. title: Hr And Recruitment Specialist (Americas Timezone)
description: About Reboot MonkeyReboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents. We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We're a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet.About the RoleWe will be direct with you: we have cycled through 84 people in approximately 2 years. Your job is to break that pattern. We are not looking for someone to post jobs and schedule interviews. We need someone who can look at that number — 84 churned in 24 months — and build the structured process that makes it stop. That means quality-over-quantity sourcing, structured interviews with consistent scoring, onboarding that actually prepares people to work, and early performance signal tracking that catches a bad fit in week 2, not week 8.This role is critical to everything else we are trying to build. Without a functioning hiring pipeline, we cannot staff the operations, sales, and finance functions that the company needs to grow. You own that pipeline. Why LATAM?We are building a 24/7 recruitment operation. With our existing team spread across CET and APAC timezones, we need recruitment coverage in the Americas timezone (UTC-3 to UTC-5) to ensure candidates are being sourced, screened, and moved through the pipeline around the clock. Brazil and Argentina are our priority markets for this role due to strong talent pools, timezone alignment, and cultural fit with our global remote team. Day-to-day you will:Manage the full hiring pipeline for all open roles in Recruitee — from sourcing to offerWrite and post job descriptions in Recruitee (you will improve on the ones we already have)Screen CVs against role requirements — moving qualified candidates forward, rejecting unqualified ones fastConduct first-stage screening calls to assess fit, availability, and English fluencyCoordinate trial tasks with candidates and score results against the rubricOwn onboarding for every new hire: send access credentials, set up their first-week schedule, run the 30-minute orientation callTrack hiring pipeline metrics weekly: candidates screened, interviews scheduled, time-to-fill per roleReport to Michel (CEO) weekly with a pipeline updateProvide Americas-timezone recruitment coverage as part of our 24/7 hiring operation Over time: build and maintain an onboarding playbook so the process is consistent regardless of roleWhat You'll Own (KPIs)These are your KPIs. Shared upfront, reviewed every 2 weeks for the first 3 months, then monthly:Candidates screened: 20+ per week during active hiring phases Interview-to-hire ratio: 5:1 or better (5 interviews for every hire made) Time-to-fill: 21 days or less from job posting to offer accepted, per role Onboarding completion: 100% of new hires complete the onboarding checklist before their second week Weekly pipeline report: Delivered every Friday by EOD The primary metric is time-to-fill. Every day a critical role is unfilled is a day the CEO absorbs that work. Speed with quality is the target. Compensation and Terms Monthly retainer: EUR 600–800 depending on experience (competitive for LATAM market) Arrangement: Freelance / contractor — you invoice us monthly Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week Performance reviews: Every 2 weeks for the first 3 months, then monthly

Quem nós somosNós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão: Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.Js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade. Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata. Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript. Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) Gympass Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!) Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!) Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Desenvolvedor C Sênior
description:
Inscrição Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo atualizado para: Descrição da Vaga Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) C# Sênior com sólida experiência em todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software. Buscamos alguém que domine boas práticas de engenharia, esteja familiarizado com arquiteturas modernas em ambiente cloud (AWS) e seja capaz de liderar tecnicamente projetos de médio e grande porte. O(a) candidato(a) ideal deve ser capaz de conceber, desenvolver, testar e gerenciar aplicações complexas de forma consistente, garantindo alta qualidade, performance e segurança no código. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações escaláveis em C#/.NET 8 seguindo padrões de DDD e CQRS, garantindo alta performance e segurança. Implementar e evoluir camadas de domínio e aplicação utilizando MediatR, AutoMapper e FluentValidation. Trabalhar com Entity Framework Core e Dapper em banco PostgreSQL, realizando modelagem, otimização de consultas e manutenção de migrations. Integrar e gerenciar serviços AWS, incluindo ECS, RDS Aurora, S3, SES, ElastiCache/Redis, Secrets Manager e CloudFormation. Desenvolver e manter integrações com provedores de identidade (Azure AD, Okta, OpenID Connect) e APIs externas (Microsoft Graph, OData). Implementar e monitorar jobs em background com Hangfire e comunicação real-time com SignalR. Criar e manter suítes de testes automatizados com xUnit (unitários e integração). Participar ativamente de code reviews, definições de arquitetura e mentoria de desenvolvedores mais juniores em ambiente ágil (Scrum/Kanban). Colaborar na manutenção de pipelines CI/CD (Azure Pipelines e AWS CodePipeline) e na containerização de serviços com Docker. Qualificações Obrigatórias Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área correlata. 5+ anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento back-end com C# e .NET (preferencialmente .NET 6+). Experiência sólida com Entity Framework Core e bancos PostgreSQL ou similares, incluindo modelagem relacional e otimização de queries. Conhecimento prático de padrões de arquitetura: DDD, CQRS, SOLID, Clean Code. Experiência com serviços AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, SES ou equivalentes). Proficiência com Git, Docker e pipelines de CI/CD. Experiência com caching distribuído (Redis) e processamento assíncrono/background jobs. Fluência em português;
inglês intermediário ouavançado (leitura de documentação e colaboração técnica). Diferenciais Experiência com MediatR, AutoMapper e FluentValidation. Vivência com Dapper para operações de leitura otimizadas. Conhecimento em Hangfire para agendamento de tarefas. Experiência com SignalR para comunicação real-time. Familiaridade com AWS Bedrock ou outras plataformas de IA generativa. Experiência com arquiteturas multi-tenant. Vivência com CloudFormation ou Terraform para IaC. Conhecimento em processamento de documentos (PDF, Excel, OCR). Experiência com provedores de identidade federada (Azure AD, Okta, OpenID Connect). Certificação AWS (Solutions Architect, Developer ou equivalente). Benefícios Trabalho 100% remoto Vale refeição ou vale alimentação Auxílio estudo Auxílio home office Desconto em cursos de inglês com a Open English Plano de saúde
